All songs include full difficulty levels.

We will continue to work hard to bring you more enjoyable songs.

thank you!

notes.title: EarlyAccess Patch note #01
notes.notes:
Hi! Beat Smash Players!  

In this patch,

we've fixed and updated elements to play in a convenient way.

We will try our best to deliver the joy of K-POP to everyone through BEATSABER game by steady updates   

 I will be loved by steady updates!
 (Let's live in Bitsaver! ^^)


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36349946/a3b4819520cb659878607514ead10bfa3abde5d2.png



UI


ㅇ The design of the main UI has changed.
    -Improved to look much cleaner and better!

ㅇ Height has been lowered overall.
    - In the meantime, players had to lift their head and look highly, but We fixed it low for the player's convenience!

ㅇ We've redesigned the graphics a bit cleaner.  !
    -Increase the resolution and you will see more clearly!


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36349946/56f7521a8ba02e45f7ee0bae5dd28bbf2673abb9.png



Add option

ㅇ The following options have been added.
   - Language settings (English, Korean, Jepanise, Chinise)
   - Practice Mode: If you choose the practice mode, the game will continue to play without fail.
   - Section 1 mode: You can only play section 1!
   - Height setting
   - Vibration intensity control, effect sound control


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36349946/bc83c5c8eea6f5ecf5fb457e344a6438d2adf494.png


Play music change

ㅇ Updated to the music players want.

- IDOL : BTS
- Boy Whit Love : BTS
- SPRING DAY : BTS
- DNA : BTS
- FAKELOVE : BTS
- MIC DROP : BTS
- FANCY : TWICE
- LIKEY : TWICE
- FEELSPECIAL : TWICE
- KILLTHIS LOVE : BLACK PINK
- DDU-DU-DDU-DU : BLACK PINK
- FANTASTIC BABY : BIGBANG
- BANGBANGBANG : BIGBANG
- GANGNAM STYLE : PSY
- GENTLEMAN : PSY
- DADDY : PSY
- BBOOM BBOOM : MOMOLAND
- ICY : ITZY
- Dalla Dalla : ITZY
- KOKO-POP : EXO
- OBSESSION : EXO
- TEMPO : EXO
- HIT : SEVENTEEN
- Don’t Wanna Cry : SEVENTEEN


 Great Level Author 

ㅇ We reflected the notes of the great creators.
By exposing the names of the creators
We hope to grow together.


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36349946/10e9a5773358781372dcaf69e1bf55f4828c9feb.png



{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36349946/4536767d63dd8c007d9774aab9fd2aeba60b7e52.jpg
